references.text: Balaam begins his first prophecy in the same way with "וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ" (he took up his proverb)
Balaam uses the same introductory formula "וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ" in his third prophecy
Moses uses a similar exhortation "הַאֲזִינוּ" (listen) when he addresses the people of Israel
Deborah uses the same expression "הַאֲזִינוּ" when she calls kings and princes to listen
Isaiah uses "הַאֲזִינוּ" and "שִׁמְעוּ" together in a similar exhortation to listen
The psalmist uses "הַאֲזִינוּ" in the same way to call all nations to listen
Elihu uses "הַאֲזִינוּ" when he asks Job's friends to listen to his words
